answer: Work-slot deposit burn: each agent pays 200 POA for one of 50 work slots. A slot is an island — no identity can hold two. It locks for 20 epochs and burns if the agent fakes work; honest agents get it back in full. Forging 100 identities costs 20,000 POA; one honest agent risks only 200 and keeps earnings whole. A whisper of fraud triggers a peer check, and the burn drives the attacker's balance to its nadir, making mass forgery a losing bet.
